hero_copy.label: Hero introduction
hero_copy.value: I’m Haley Reeder. I design sales and partner learning for complex products, then carry the work through development, LMS delivery, support, and reporting. I start with what people need to do on the job and build the practice and tools that help them do it.

hero_intro_primary.label: Experience summary
hero_intro_primary.value: I began in high-school classrooms and K–12 curriculum. That work taught me to plan for different learners, notice when an explanation misses, and adjust. I now bring that judgment to enterprise learning, live facilitation, learning platforms, and AI quality work.

hero_intro.label: Projects hero introduction
hero_intro.value: These projects show the learning I built, the systems I supported, and the decisions behind each.

family_intro.label: Project types introduction
family_intro.value: Start with the kind of work you want to see, then open the deeper case studies and interactive examples.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I take learning from source material through practice, review, delivery, and revision. These projects show how that work changes with the seller task and the amount of support people need.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph
overview_body_one.value: I start with the learner decision, build the needed context and practice, then choose the delivery route.

examples_intro.label: Examples introduction
examples_intro.value: Choose a format to see my design and delivery decisions.

hero_intro_primary.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro_primary.value: I review AI output against the task, approved evidence, and intended audience. I define the scoring question, explain material issues, and calibrate decisions so the review is useful to the next person.

overview_heading.label: Overview heading
overview_heading.value: From evidence to a review decision.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: A reliable evaluation program gives reviewers one traceable path: define the question, apply the standard, capture the evidence, explain the judgment, and compare it with a benchmark.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: Choose a pipeline stage to see the evidence, rationale, and reviewer action that make each decision traceable.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I design the handoffs around learning work so a request, source file, review decision, and approved output do not get lost between tools. The reporting case shows one workflow I automated, while the demos show collaboration and review patterns.

areas_intro.label: Workflow areas introduction
areas_intro.value: I connect the request, source, reviewer decision, and published resource so the next owner can find the current state.

hero_intro.label: Contact hero introduction
hero_intro.value: Reach me on LinkedIn about a role, collaboration, or a question about the work here. I keep my direct contact information private.
